Portfolio news brief — 2 September 2026

Market and major-name developments
- The 10-year Treasury note yield reached a fresh multiyear high on Wednesday as inflation and debt concerns pressured global government borrowing costs. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was last seen unchanged at 4.796%. (CNBC)
- GoPro is the latest company embarking on an artificial intelligence pivot . Its shares surged 40% yesterday after the company announced a merger and said it would expand into the data center and defense markets. (CNBC)
- September gets blamed for being the market's worst month, but the calendar isn't what has me worried this year. What concerns me is what happens when a market already heavily dependent on artificial intelligence spending, leverage, and a handful of giant companies finally has to prove those expectations are justified. (The Motley Fool)
- Intuitive Surgical ( ISRG -0.12% ) has many qualities that appeal to investors, from a fantastic moat to a strong track record of earnings growth. But in recent months, that hasn't been enough to lift the stock. (The Motley Fool)

Meta (META)
- Meta's $18 billion social media settlement lifts a legal overhang that some analysts say could clear the way for a wave of new AI product launches. The tech giant went to trial in August after a lawsuit filed by 29 U.S. (CNBC)
- Meta Platforms has become a battleground stock. (CNBC)

Bitcoin (BTC)
- CrowdStrike and the Justice Department have dismantled Sality, a botnet that has circulated since 2003 and spent its last eight years hijacking cryptocurrency payments by rewriting wallet addresses on infected computers, the security firm said Tuesday. Sality itself did little beyond delivering other people's payloads. (Decrypt)
- Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner . The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. (Decrypt)

Ethereum (ETH)
- Japan-listed Remixpoint sold its entire altcoin portfolio as the company shifts to a bitcoin-only cryptocurrency strategy. Remixpoint sold 901.45 ETH, 13,920 SOL, 1.19 million XRP, and 2.8 million DOGE on Sept. (The Block)

Eli Lilly (LLY; XLV top-five holding)
- David Ricks, Eli Lilly CEO, joins 'Squawk on the Street' to discuss plans to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.88B, the company's growth strategy, and more. (CNBC)

Microsoft (MSFT; VOO top-five holding)
- Longtime partners OpenAI and Microsoft both indicated they were suffering from outages for key products on Monday, though there were no reports that the outages were connected. OpenAI said ChatGPT Work, its enterprise artificial intelligence agent, has been experiencing elevated errors and latency for roughly three hours. (CNBC)

Informational only — verify primary sources before making investment decisions.
Routine price moves and stock-picking speculation are intentionally excluded.
